title: Music library
description: Index of a client's music. Lives at clients/<slug>/assets/music/LIBRARY.json next to the audio files. Only royalty-free or client-supplied tracks. List it with `python3 tools/brief.py music <slug>`.

licence.description: Licence name (e.g. "CC0", "Pixabay Content License", "supplied by the client") or a licence file relative to assets/music/ (.txt, .pdf, .md, .html), which must exist

source.description: Where it came from: URL, author, or "client"

mood.description: A few words: calm, warm, upbeat …
